## About
Metrius Electrical is a full service electrical contracting company for residential and commercial customers in the Spring Valley and Lemon Grove area, serving San Diego and the surrounding communities. We handle new construction, renovations, tenant improvements, service upgrades, retrofits and interior, exterior and landscape lighting.
From design to finish, our estimators, project managers and technicians work to get your project done on time, on budget and up to code. We know a service interruption costs you time, so we focus on getting you back online quickly without putting your equipment at risk. Safety comes first, and our people get ongoing education to keep up with best practices.
We're rated 4.8 on Google from 26 reviews. If there's anything else we can do to make your experience better, just ask.

## Services
- Residential and commercial wiring: Upgrades and repairs for new houses and remodels.
- Appliance and lighting installations: Electrical circuits installed to the latest code requirements.
- Power meter and electrical panel service: Service upgrades and replacements for safety and reliability.
- Solar installation and LED lighting retrofits: Solar installs and lighting or LED retrofits.
- Architectural lighting design: Fixtures installed to set a mood or highlight your decor.
- Bathroom and spa wiring: Code compliant circuits, shock protection and GFI circuit installations.
- Exterior lighting and power supply: Underground circuits, concealed mood lighting and sensors.
- Data network and telephone installations: Wired or wireless computer circuits and phone lines for home or office.
- Audiovisual speaker and cable wiring: Concealed speaker and cable wiring for multi-room systems.

## FAQ
Q: Do you match other electricians' prices?
A: Yes. We will meet or beat a competitor's price.

Q: Can I get a weekend or evening appointment?
A: Yes. Saturday, Sunday and evening appointments are available. Give us a call to set one up.

Q: When should I call an electrician?
A: Don't wait for burning smells or dimming lights. Call us as soon as you have any questions about your electrical system. Your safety comes first.
